$comment: Order 25 (R2-075): the SCP that AWS Budgets attaches to the Workloads OU when actual spend reaches the owner's monthly ceiling. It stops new spend-creating launches (worker tasks, new services, instances, databases, model invocations: Bedrock's Converse calls are authorized as bedrock:InvokeModel*) while scaling a service down stays possible, and keeps everything else, data and recovery included, untouched. It is a backstop that acts on billing data hours late: the application's reservations and job limits remain the cap (R2-075), and an attempt already running ends at its own 8 h wall.
